purpose: Derive the C2-LT-B3 neuro-sensory-cognitive promotion queue into source-specific deep-read tasks so every candidate source must be read in context before Source Card promotion, variable extraction, downgrade decisions or model admission.

scope.selectionRule: Derive one queued source-specific extraction task for every candidate source attached to every C2-LT-B3 promotion row.
currentLimitations: This queue derives deep-read tasks; it does not contain completed source-specific extractions.
A queued task is not evidence that the cited source supports the domain claim seed.
Candidate URLs require source-context reading and may still need manual access if a publisher, government site or archive blocks automated checks.
No task may be promoted into reviewed Source Cards, variables, endpoints, downgrade checks or calibrated models until exact source-context fields and fresh review are complete.

queueDefaults.minimumExtractionQuestion: For this C2-LT-B3 domain-source pair, what exact claim, endpoint, population/setting, mechanism/effect signal, uncertainty, transfer boundary and downgrade trigger can this source support without overclaiming?

remainingWork: Read each source in context and fill the required extraction slots.
Promote extracted rows into local source-context review only after exact source text, endpoint and boundary fields are available.
Send reviewed rows through independent fresh review before creating reviewed Source, variable, endpoint, uncertainty, transfer-boundary or downgrade artifacts.

nonClaims: This queue does not validate that any source supports any domain claim.
This queue does not complete source-specific reading.
This queue does not complete independent fresh review.
This queue does not complete Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards, transfer-boundary cards or downgrade checks.
This queue does not authorize calibrated prediction, individual advice, intervention ranking, clinical-validity claims or individual death-date output.
